message:
feat(github-actions-cicd): add GitHub Actions CI/CD package for Terraform, Java and Next.js

New APM package: 9 knowledge skills (composing building blocks, Terraform 1.17,
AWS OIDC, OCI auth, Java Maven 3.10/Gradle 9.8, container images, Next.js 16.4,
blast radius, supply chain), the cicd-pipeline-engineer executor and the
cicd-pipeline-reviewer advisor, 4 scoped workflow rules and the
/building-cicd-pipelines command. Plan model: GitHub Pro/Team private repos by
default with an explicit weaker Free variant. Facts verified 2026-10-30;
P6 quality loop: 2 rounds, 0 HIGH, skills 97-99.5, audit 9.7/10.

Not yet listed in the root apm.yml/lock (.claude/ not regenerated in this commit).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(agent-package-builder): test package source in parallel and add scoped install

- P5 install rehearsal is scripts/scoped_install.py: one package in a throwaway
  workspace/.sbx sandbox, deploy compared with the source; full root install only in P8
- P6 reviewers (validate, test, audit) read packages/<pkg>/ and run in parallel;
  state_event round-start writes a .running marker shown as running on the dashboard
- pilot report goes to execution-N/pilot/; dashboard rendered at every boundary
- verify_skill.py allows literal .github/ only for packages/github-actions-cicd
- includes the score/render commands and auto-render added to the state scripts
  outside this run (accepted by the user)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
